controls: Separate-process cold continuation of the altered exit. Ordinary re-entry/return, then every planned reciprocal crossing replayed in reverse with normal AI, survival and actual acquired Ward. No scene regeneration or supply reset.

possessions.name: Tallow Torch
possessions.description: A rush dipped in rendered fat. It smells of the animal it came from. It will burn for a while.

possessions.name: a crude blade
possessions.description: Iron, poorly kept. It will serve.

possessions.name: a leather jack
possessions.description: Cured hide, stitched with sinew. Old work. It will hold.

possessions.name: moist pebble
possessions.description: Perpetually damp. Woven round with twine by hands that knew what they were doing. Certain stones feel different when this is on thy person.

possessions.name: flint shard
possessions.description: A sharp cutting chip. Throw one for a distracting clatter; it shatters and is lost.

possessions.name: The Faceted Ward
possessions.description: A warped disc of verdigris bronze, the metal buckled and re-set so many times the original form is barely legible. A face was once pressed into the front — mouth open, eyes shut. Most of the features have been beaten flat. It turns a blow poorly. It is better than nothing.
